thesis: Vertically integrated Earth observation company that designs, manufactures, launches, and operates its own satellites — now rebranding itself as the infrastructure company for 'Persistent Global Intelligence (PGI)'. 20+ satellites in orbit with the AI-first Merlin constellation on track to launch ~Oct 2026, the key binary catalyst. Q1 2026 delivered +80% YoY revenue to $6.1M (beat), a 32% improvement in adjusted EBITDA loss, and first-ever positive operating cash flow, while GAAP EPS of -$0.84 was driven almost entirely by a ~$113M non-cash change in the fair value of financial instruments. FY2025 revenue was $17.71M (+37.6%) at ~72% gross margin; TTM revenue is ~$20.4M (+58%). A new $18M one-year international defense contract plus SpaceKnow and SynMax partnerships broaden the defense/government pipeline, though customer concentration, a CFO transition, and Merlin launch execution keep this a high-risk, high-reward speculative position.

drivers: Merlin AI-first constellation launches successfully (~Oct 2026), enabling 1-meter daily global remapping and real-time onboard detection
Defense/government pipeline compounds — $18M international defense contract expands, plus SpaceKnow and SynMax 'Persistent Global Intelligence' partnerships convert to recurring revenue
Sovereign/technology-transfer model replicates (Portugal, Malaysia, Albania, Australia) at 3-5 similar deals annually
First-ever positive operating cash flow (Q1 2026) proves a credible path to sustained profitability
Acquisition interest from Planet, a defense prime, or a data/analytics platform at $800M-$1.2B

base_case.assumptions: Merlin launches on or near schedule in late 2026; the $18M defense contract renews and 2-3 additional sovereign/defense deals are signed; revenue grows toward $35-40M by 2027 on ~50%+ TTM momentum; adjusted EBITDA losses continue to narrow toward break-even by 2027-2028; CFO transition completes without disruption.

risks: Merlin launch failure or material technical delay destroys credibility and forces dilutive financing
Customer concentration blow-up — a small number of large defense/sovereign customers drive the majority of revenue
Competitive pressure from Planet Labs' larger constellation and entrenched Maxar government relationships
CFO transition and management turnover create execution and governance uncertainty
Small-cap liquidity, secondary block trades (e.g. 10M shares at $9.94), and warrant/note conversions dilute holders

catalysts.event: Q2 2026 earnings — first read on revenue momentum after +80% Q1, adjusted EBITDA trajectory, and durability of positive operating cash flow
Merlin AI-first constellation launch — the key binary catalyst; 1-meter daily remapping with onboard AI processing
New sovereign and defense contract signings — expansion of the $18M defense deal and SpaceKnow / SynMax partnerships into recurring PGI revenue
CFO successor appointment — completion of the Rick Dunn management transition

key_risks: Binary Merlin launch catalyst (~Oct 2026) — failure or delay could crater the stock and credibility
Customer concentration — a few large defense/sovereign customers drive most revenue and backlog
CFO transition (Rick Dunn stepping down) introduces governance and execution risk
TTM net loss of -$90.5M (largely non-cash fair-value charges) and small-cap liquidity amplify volatility and dilution risk
Competition from Planet Labs' 200+ satellite constellation and Maxar's deep government relationships
